point_in_time_capability.available_at_semantics: event_ts is set to the ex_date close, 15:00 Asia/Shanghai; available_at is set to the announcement_date close, 15:00 Asia/Shanghai. If announcement_date is missing, available_at defensively falls back to the ex_date close and the fallback is counted in availability_diagnostics.

availability_diagnostics.zero_day_lag_known_limitation: Records announced on the ex-date use announcement-date 15:00 available_at; they remain invisible at that ex-date open.
